info.description:
Every byte of content in this API is already encrypted when it arrives and still encrypted when it leaves. The server holds ciphertext, digests and counters; the keys live in URL fragments, which browsers do not transmit.

Writing a client means implementing format v1: start from docs/CRYPTO.md and make crypto/vectors/v1.json pass.
